name: scientific-workbench
display_name: Scientific Workbench for Life Sciences R&D
description: Enterprise AI platform for life sciences R&D on Snowflake. Combines Cortex Agents (Discovery Agent with Claude Sonnet 5.5), 23 registered scientific tools (NVIDIA BioNeMo GPU NIMs, Native Snowpark, PubMed/ClinicalTrials Search), Cortex Analyst semantic views, multi-step workflow pipelines, notebooks, and a Next.js Snowflake App Runtime (SAR) application.

requires_marketplace.name: PubMed Biomedical Research Corpus
requires_marketplace.note: Enables PubMed biomedical literature search (38M+ articles) in Discovery Agent and literature tools.

requires_marketplace.name: ClinicalTrials.gov Research Database
requires_marketplace.note: Enables clinical trial search and outcome analytics in Discovery Agent.

features: Cortex Agent (Discovery Agent with Claude Sonnet 5.5)
Cortex Analyst (4 Semantic Views: Genomics, Compounds, Clinical, Chemistry)
Cortex Search (Tool Registry, Asset Search, PubMed)
NVIDIA BioNeMo NIMs (GenMol, MolMIM, DiffDock, Boltz-2, ProteinMPNN, RFdiffusion, OpenFold2/3, Evo2, MSA-Search)
notes: Requires an NVIDIA API key from build.nvidia.com for hosted NIM endpoints. Optional NGC API key for SPCS container mirroring.
